description: Defines the 'Write' interface representing a logical data source write operation in Apache Spark, including methods for batch and streaming writes, custom metrics, and driver metrics.

classes.name: Write
classes.description: Interface representing a logical data source write operation, supporting batch and streaming, with methods for custom metrics.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the write instance.

methods.name: toBatch
methods.description: Returns a BatchWrite object for batch data writing; throws exception if not supported.

methods.name: toStreaming
methods.description: Returns a StreamingWrite object for streaming data writing; throws exception if not supported.

methods.name: supportedCustomMetrics
methods.description: Returns an array of supported custom metrics.

methods.name: reportDriverMetrics
methods.description: Returns an array of custom metrics collected at the driver side.
